# Integration Checklist: Harness Surface Inventory and Gap Taxonomy

**Purpose**: Validate that HRNS-001 requirements define external-candidate, OKF, and downstream HRNS integration boundaries without creating runtime dependencies.
**Created**: 2026-07-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all PRD OQ-6 starting candidates represented in the required matrix boundary or intentionally optional with evidence conditions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are mapped HRNS surfaces required for every external candidate row? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Are OKF normative revision, maturity, reference-tooling evidence, compatibility gaps, and disposition all required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the candidate recommendation vocabulary clear enough to distinguish `reference pattern`, `future spike`, `optional adapter candidate`, `defer`, `reject`, and `unknown`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are primary-source evidence types specific enough to prevent secondary articles or memory-derived claims from becoming authority? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the distinction between the normative OKF specification and non-required reference tooling explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do the spec, research, and plan consistently keep all external candidates non-required until a dedicated downstream decision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Research §Candidate matrix]
- [ ] CHK008 Do CAR/G56R references consistently remain non-authoritative when unmerged and still visible for cross-roadmap ownership? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for external candidate fields that cannot be supported by current primary evidence? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for compatibility gaps between OKF spec behavior and reference tooling behavior? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Are downstream HRNS ownership requirements complete enough for HRNS-003 through HRNS-014 to reuse matrix and taxonomy rows? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
